channel.title: Contractor UK Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Contractor UK Limited (contractoruk.com)

item.title: IR35: IT contractors ‘most concerned about off-payroll working rules’
item.description: A rock and a hard place? The choice between no work and only inside IR35 roles is unsettling limited company IT contractors the most in 2026.

item.title: Statutory Sick Pay (SSP) for umbrella company contractors: an April 2026 explainer
item.description: Since SSP’s new state enforcer isn’t fully operational yet, umbrella contractors may need to stand their ground, as three changes to the ‘safety net’ come into effect.

item.title: Contractors warned over HMRC charging £3.5 billion too much
item.description: A spike for the .gov Personal Tax Account website looks assured, as the taxman is found overcharging taxpayers by £625 each.

item.title: JSL rules ‘are HMRC’s way to make contractor umbrella company clients give a sh*t where their money goes’
item.description: An unconventional framing of why the taxman has chosen to put agencies and end-clients on the hook is a new webinar’s most memorable moment.

item.title: Government unveils ‘Umbrella Company Regulations consultation’
item.description: More than 30 proposed changes to the Conduct Regulations are set to ‘reshape how the temporary labour market is regulated.’ And contractors have 12 weeks to have their say.

item.title: Why PAYE overcharging by HMRC is every contractor’s problem
item.description: Since few contractors can now say ‘Not me, guv,’ the IR35-hit and other PSCs must use the government’s own free tool to temper the reality of the tax walls closing in.

item.title: How a buyer’s market in UK property for 2026 is contractors’ double-edge sword
item.description: High-net-worth types eyeing their first buy-to-let have an open door. But nervous of ‘non-standard income’ where a broker isn’t involved, mortgage lenders won’t be moving much more.

item.title: Blocking the 2025 Loan Charge settlement opportunity from being a genuine opportunity is… HMRC
item.description: A new technical note shows the taxman taking with one hand and giving with the other. He must be persuaded (or instructed) to ditch his balance sheet-led approach.

item.title: Should a new limited company not making much money pay a salary/dividend?
item.description: It will feel counterintuitive, but paying a small, tax-efficient salary from a company yet to cook on gas can have multiple benefits.

item.title: ‘Make Work Pay…’ heralds a new era for umbrella company compliance
item.description: The open consultation ‘Make Work Pay: Modernising the Agency Work Regulatory Framework,’ marks a HUGE step towards ending the ‘grey area’ for contractors.
